{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/sh

# Flux batch script (translated from Slurm)

# Slurm requested:
#   -J tools
#   -N 1
#   -n 1
#   -o tools.eo%j
#   -e tools.eo%j
#   -t 01:00:00

flux alloc \
  -N 1 \
  -n 1 \
  --time=1h \
  bash -lc '

# NOTE: Slurm job name (-J tools) is not expressed here as a portable Flux batch directive.
# Performance implication: none (metadata only), but job identification in monitoring/accounting may be less clear.

# Slurm used %j for output/error; approximate with Flux job id and keep combined output as in original.
exec >"tools.eo${FLUX_JOB_ID}" 2>&1

ulimit -c 0
ulimit -s unlimited
set -e

. ~rodierq/DEV_57/MNH-PHYEX070-b95d84d7/conf/profile_mesonh-LXifort-R8I4-MNH-V5-6-2-ECRAD140-MPIAUTO-O2

ln -sf ${SRC_MESONH}/src/LIB/Python/* .

module purge
module load python/3.7.6

python3 plot_16JAN.py
convert *.png 16JAN.pdf
'
"
}
